artworks.title: Three Cupids and a Bear
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting three cherubs holding ornate staffs that support a circular platform, on which a bear is resting. The cherubs have wings and one of them is looking upwards. The bear is reclined with its head on its paws. Intricate foliage and decorative details surround the scene. Below the bear, there is a plaque inscribed with the date "1529." The drawing features detailed line work and fine hatching typical of the early 16th century.

artworks.title: Three Cupids and a Bear
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cherubs supporting a decorative emblem with a bear on top. The engraving features three cherubic figures at the bottom of the image, each holding stylized staffs adorned with acanthus leaves. The cherubs are rendered in an ornate style, each with wings and pudgy limbs. Above them is an emblem dated "1529" with a monogram "AG". Perched above this emblem is a bear looking downwards. The background is richly etched with fine lines.

artworks.title: Sprig of Ornamental Foliage with Two Masks and Two Dolphins
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and curling lines forming a symmetrical pattern similar to botanical elements. Shapes resembling elongated leaves, flower petals, and curved stems are interconnected in the design, suggesting a lush plant or vine. The central arrangement hints at a stylized bouquet with intricate floral motifs. The lines create a Gothic or Baroque floral art aesthetic, interlacing in a nature-inspired tapestry.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring stylized plant motifs. The central focus is a symmetrical arrangement of ornate leaves and abstract flowers or trumpet-like shapes emerging from a vessel. This vessel has a classic, urn-like form, with defined ridges and a fluted base. The design is intricate, showcasing patterns that curl and loop around the central motif. The background consists of fine cross-hatching, creating a textured effect that enhances the foreground details. The style and execution suggest influences from Renaissance or early Baroque decorative arts.

artworks.title: Scroll Ornament with Seated Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cherubic figure surrounded by ornate floral patterns. The image shows a putto-like figure intertwined with detailed acanthus leaves. The cherubic figure appears playful within the foliage. The floral elements wrap around the central figure, depicting intricate line work and texture in classical ornamental style.

artworks.title: High Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative motif. The artwork features a baroque-like ornamentation with putti intertwined among stylized foliage and floral patterns. Intricately carved floral garlands cascade around the figures, showcasing detailed leaves and blooms. The putti are depicted interacting with the ornamentation, enhancing the composition. This is in the style of Renaissance ornamental engravings.

artworks.title: Ornament with Naked Couple
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring two full-bodied figures standing closely together. Both figures are depicted without clothing, with the figure on the left having long hair tied back and pronounced facial features, while the figure on the right has curly hair falling over their forehead. Surrounding the figures is an ornate design with floral and mythical elements, including a central winged being with a human face and smaller cherubic faces, interwoven with leaf patterns. The background has a finely hatched texture that contrasts with the detailed foreground design.

artworks.title: Dancing Children
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs dancing. The cherubs have curly hair and are shown in various dance poses, holding hands and moving in a circular formation. The drawing features detailed textures, intricate hair and limb detailing, and a dark background that contrasts with the lighter cherubs.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Child on the Back of a Sphinx
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design. The illustration features a vertical arrangement of foliage, creatures, and cherubic figures intertwined with botanical elements. The design is decorative, with movement created by the curling leaves and stems. Imaginary creatures with leonine heads and human-like features are integrated into the foliage. The figures interact with the floral patterns. The drawing shows shading and line work with a contrast between the foreground and background. Nature-inspired motifs and mythical beings are depicted in a classical style of ornamentation.

artworks.title: Three Buckles of Girdles Side by Side
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornamental designs featuring intricate motifs. The drawing shows three distinct symmetrical designs that appear to be architectural or decorative motifs. Each design consists of elaborate scrollwork and foliage forms intertwined with human faces. The faces emerge from the leafy forms, adding a mystical and classical effect. The central motif features a nude torso with arms that blend into the surrounding decorative elements, giving the illusion that the human form is part of the spiraling leaves. Above these motifs, the initials "AG" can be seen, and the date "1536" is inscribed. The designs are drawn in monochrome, with strong lines and shading to create depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Cross Panel with Vine in Center and Tritons' Couple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative frieze with mythological figures and floral elements. The drawing features an intricate and symmetrical composition with mythological figures intertwined with an array of scrolling acanthus leaves and flowers. In the center, two adult figures appear standing back to back, with cherubic figures engaged in gestures and interactions around them. The foliage forms swirling patterns that fill the space, creating movement and harmony. Faces emerging from the leafy forms on either side suggest a connection between human and natural elements. The use of line and shadow gives the drawing texture, emphasizing the three-dimensional quality of the forms.

artworks.title: Ornament with Foliage and a Child in the Center
artworks.description: This is a drawing of foliage interwoven with a cherubic figure. The scene features elaborate, curling leaves with detailed veining. A cherubic figure is nestled within the leaves, its body partially obscured by the foliage. The background is densely hatched, adding depth and contrast to the design. The style appears to be indicative of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Ornament with Mask, Eagle between Satyrs Below
artworks.description: The image features intricate swirling lines and curvaceous shapes forming an abstract composition. At the center is a large, bearded face carved into a decorative pillar, surrounded by vases with foliage and ribbons. Mythical creatures with human-like faces and avian features perch atop the structure. Below, two satyr-like figures with goat legs flank a phoenix-like bird with outstretched wings.

artworks.title: Ornament with Mask
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythological creatures and figures intertwined in a decorative style. The imagery includes a central bearded face with an exaggerated expression surrounded by anthropomorphic figures and mythical creatures. Two large, mythical figures with long robes and head coverings flank the central face. Above the central face, there is a muscular figure with a wrapped headdress and a creature resembling a goat with a human body on the opposite side. The lower section of the image includes cherubic figures and detailed ornamentation featuring floral and scroll motifs. The entire piece is rendered with fine linework and showcases a high level of detail typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Ornament with Mask
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of an ornate grotesque design with mythical figures and ornate decoration. The central grotesque face has exaggerated features and is framed symmetrically by cherubic figures and classical drapery. The composition includes vines, festoons, and intricate armor pieces. Each corner is adorned with mythical creatures, plants, or architectural motifs. It has a style reminiscent of renaissance engravings, with meticulous line work and shading.

artworks.title: Ornament with Trophy of Arms
artworks.description: The image depicts a central bat with spread wings, surrounded by intricate shapes and swirling lines. Above the bat is a lantern-like structure, flanked by two humanoid figures wearing draped garments. Additional elements include a snail, grasshopper, and stag's head. At the bottom, two cherub-like figures interact with medieval helmets and weapons.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling and intertwined lines and shapes creating an intricate pattern. The design includes leafy tendrils and floral forms that resemble a flourishing vine. In the center, a face emerges, integrated with the foliage. The overall composition blends natural elements with symmetry and ornate detail, resembling decorative scrollwork found in classical architecture or antique prints.

artworks.title: High Fruits with Ornaments
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design featuring mythological creatures and floral motifs. The artwork includes two sphinx-like creatures at the bottom, floral patterns, blossoming flowers, butterflies, and ornate botanical elements. The design is highly detailed and rendered in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Ornament with Vase and Two Female Figures
artworks.description: The drawing features a decorative motif with mythical creatures and floral patterns. Two faun-like figures flank an ornate vase from which elaborate flowers and vines extend upwards symmetrically. The figures have human torsos and heads transitioning into hairy, goat-like legs. The year "1553" and a monogram are inscribed at the top. The engravings emphasize a baroque and intricate style reminiscent of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and organic shapes forming an abstract pattern. These shapes resemble ornate foliage and floral designs, with curling leaves and pointed petal-like forms intertwining throughout the composition. Some parts suggest stylized lion heads and a human torso. The detailed curves and symmetry in the artwork hint at lavish ornamentation similar to classical architectural designs.

artworks.title: Commemoration of the Dead
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.3 x 7.4 cm (4 7/16 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a standing nude woman in profile, facing right with her body slightly turned towards the viewer. She has long hair flowing down her back. In her right hand, she holds an apple and in her left hand, she holds an hourglass above her head. A draped cloth partially covers her left arm. Surrounding her are symbolic objects like a globe, a skull, and a spade. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with buildings, a ship at sea, and a shining sun in the sky.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.1 x 12.6 cm (7 15/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man, focusing on the upper half of his body. The man is slightly positioned to the right, looking straight ahead. His facial features are clearly defined with a notable nose, full beard, and mustache. He wears a cap, and his hair is styled in short, controlled waves. He is clothed in a draped garment and wears a detailed chain or necklace around his neck. The background features textured lines, and there is a written inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Modesty
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a rocky surface. The individual is in a seated position, holding a staff with a small flag at the top. A small figure is perched on the flag. The person has a serene expression, braided hair, and wears a flowing robe. Beside them is a sheep, and to the left is a coat of arms with a bird. In the background, there are rocks, a sailing ship at sea, and a crumbling arch with inscribed text. Plants and rocky textures cover the ground.

artworks.title: Jan van Leyden
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31.7 x 22.6 cm (12 1/2 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait. He is in a three-quarter view, facing right. The man has a beard, mustache, and short hair covered by a hat. He wears detailed clothing with a ruffled shirt, an ornate jacket, and multiple accessories. In one hand, he holds a scepter, and in the other hand, he holds a scroll. He wears a chain around his neck and rings on his fingers. The background features coat of arms with crowns and weapons, along with lettering above the man's head and along the bottom. The entire scene is engraved with fine lines and shading.
